Compute operating characteristics for a fixed quantitative design

Source: R/f_design_plan_qtd_means.R
getOperatingCharacteristicsMeans.Rd

getOperatingCharacteristicsMeans computes the operating characteristics (probabilities of the decision categories) for a fixed (non-adaptive) two-group design with a quantitative endpoint using a normal approximation. The decision boundaries are defined by a TrialDesignPlanQuantitative object (created by getDesignQuantitative).

Usage

getOperatingCharacteristicsMeans(
  design,
  ...,
  numberOfSubjects,
  normalApproximation = TRUE,
  groups = 2,
  alternative = seq(0, 1, 0.2),
  stDev = 1
)

Arguments

design

An object of class TrialDesignPlanQuantitative describing the decision rule (target value, lower reference value, and percentiles defining the decision boundaries).

...

Ensures that all arguments (starting from the "...") are to be named and that a warning will be displayed if unknown arguments are passed.

numberOfSubjects

Numeric matrix with two columns (control, treatment) and one or more rows. Each row defines a scenario for the per-arm sample sizes to evaluate. All entries must be positive integers.

normalApproximation

Logical scalar. Whether to use the normal approximation for the sampling distribution of the difference in means. Must be TRUE for this implementation. Default: TRUE.

groups

Integer scalar. Number of groups; currently only 2 is supported (control and treatment). Default: 2.

alternative

Numeric vector. Grid of true mean differences (treatment - control) at which to evaluate the operating characteristics. Default: seq(0, 1, 0.2).

stDev

Numeric scalar. Common standard deviation for the endpoint in each group. Must be positive. Default: 1.

Value

An object of class OperatingCharcteristicsMeans (R6). The object contains fields: design, numberOfSubjects, normalApproximation, alternative, stDev, and probabilities (a data.frame with columns category, probability, nControl, nTreatment, alternative, and stDev).

Details

The function validates inputs and then calls internal helpers to compute category probabilities for each combination of sample sizes and alternatives. The categories follow the fixed-design decision rule convention used by the QTD module: "Go (Fixed)", "Go", "Indeterminate 1", "Indeterminate 2", "Stop", and "Stop (Fixed)". Probabilities are returned as part of an OperatingCharcteristicsMeans R6 object which contains both the design and a data.frame of probabilities for plotting and reporting.

Examples

# Create a decision rule
decisionRule <- getDesignQuantitative(targetValue = 1.5, lowerReferenceValue = 0)

# Evaluate operating characteristics for two sample-size scenarios
nMatrix <- matrix(c(50, 100, 75, 150), ncol = 2, byrow = TRUE)
oc <- getOperatingCharacteristicsMeans(
    design = decisionRule,
    numberOfSubjects = nMatrix,
    alternative = seq(0, 2, 0.5),
    stDev = 1
)
oc$probabilities
